final: SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS films, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) / (SELECT AVG(rating_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_avg FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating)) AS relative_to_benchmark FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating HAVING (SELECT AVG(rating_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_avg FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating)) IS NOT NULL
